questionText: Is 1% a hard limit or a starting guideline?
reason: Stated as a general guideline he 'usually advocates', with 2-3% noted as a choice some traders make. ALEX_G gives 0.5-1% / 1-2% / 3-5% banded by account type. The two educators broadly agree on the order of magnitude - which is the FIRST substantive cross-educator agreement on a risk parameter in the library - but neither states a hard ceiling.
